The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do

- Uses the catalogue only as a checklist and maps each block to a Flutter widget (DataTable or PaginatedDataTable, TabBar, an empty-state widget, SearchAnchor)
- Checks what the project already has before proposing new widgets
- Notes that DataTable is not lazy and PaginatedDataTable suits large data, and does not copy the kit's code
